title: Feel more settled,
one small practice
at a time.
hero.sub: Find your Prakriti, tell Prana how today feels, and get three small practices made for you — rooted in dinacharya, ahara and mantra.
hero.bubble: Hi, I'm Prana. Once I know you, I'll take your shape.

steps.title: Find your Prakriti
steps.body: Twelve quick questions reveal your balance of Vata, Pitta and Kapha. Prana takes on your colours.

steps.title: Tell Prana how today feels
steps.body: Anxious, overthinking, low, or just okay — one tap is all it takes. Prana listens.

steps.title: Get your three for today
steps.body: One routine, one food, one sound practice — each with a line on why it suits you. No feed, no overload.

title: A hum coach that
actually listens.
hum.body: Bhramari and Om, guided live. Prana listens through your microphone and gives one gentle tip at a time.
measures: Whether your pitch stays low and easy
hum.privacy: Your voice is analysed on your phone and never uploaded.

cards.title: Why this, for you
cards.body: Every practice tells you why it was picked — your Prakriti, your mood, your diet. Nothing is a black box.

cards.title: See what works for you
cards.body: Tap how settled you feel before and after each hum session. Over time, you see which practice helps you most.

cards.title: Just today's three
cards.body: No endless library to scroll. Three small things, done in the time you have.

title: Rooted in tradition,
careful with claims.
rooted.body: Practices come from Indian Knowledge Systems — daily routine, food and sound. Humming breath and Om chanting have been looked at in small research studies on relaxation, and we choose practices with that in mind.
rooted.note: Sattva Heals is a wellbeing companion. It does not diagnose, and it is not a substitute for professional care.

footer.help: Need to talk to someone? Tele-MANAS: 14416 (free, 24×7). In an emergency, call 112.
